define.description: Bind a name to a value.

define-fn.description: Define a function: define with a parameter list in the name slot.

case.description: Dispatch on a value, comparing with =.

and.description: Returns the deciding value, not a boolean.

or.description: Returns the deciding value, not a boolean.

let.description: Parallel bindings. Each value is evaluated in the enclosing scope.

let*.description: Sequential bindings. Each value sees the names before it.

letrec.description: Mutually visible bindings, for recursive closures.

loop.description: Named let with a counter that advances by one.

begin.description: Sequence. The last form decides the value.

use.description: Bind the results of one call, then run the body at the same indentation.

match.description: Pattern match one subject. _ matches without binding, else matches everything.

match*.description: Match several subjects at once. A clause is tried only when every pattern matches.

let-assert.description: Match a value or fail loudly, naming the pattern.

try.description: Run a body, catch a raised error, and always run the finally body.

struct.description: Define a struct. Gives a constructor named after it, a lowercased-name? predicate, and one lowercased-name-field accessor per field.

define-macro.description: Define a macro. Parameters bind to the unevaluated argument forms.

assert.description: Executable documentation. The message is required.

require.description: Load another file into this machine.

pipe-first.description: Thread a value into the first argument of each form.

pipe-last.description: Thread a value into the last argument of each form.
